rows.currentScript: Look where each word meets the next one. The end of “Ned” and the start of “ate” spell “date”. Of the other two, one sits inside one word. The other is only nearly there.
rows.whyRewrite: Says “the start of “ate”” but the hidden word uses ALL of “ate” (d+ate = date); “start” tells a child to take part of the word. Row 12 and the drafts say “the whole word” for this shape; reword to “The last letter of “Ned” and the whole word “ate” spell “date”.”
